scientific.integrity: The original reconstruction problem, the 2016 perturbative treatment, a later near-unit-ball status survey, and the 2026 polygonal extension were compared at statement level. The 2001-10-28 date is the publication date of Discrete Mathematics volume 241 issues 1-3 containing the Barker-Larman paper. The primary geometry classification is independently verified as 52A20 in the 2016 archive-era source. All new formulas are derived analytically and replayed symbolically from the packaged checker.
limitations: The result is a local disk linearization and one second-order resonant calculation, not a solution of global Barker-Larman uniqueness.
No uniform inverse estimate is claimed at nonresonant irrational angles.
Only fundamental single-harmonic resonant directions are analyzed to second order.

title: Exact resonance spectrum of the Barker–Larman tangent-chord transform
